description: 上水道の状況 [drinking water supply] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 日向市. 統計ひゅうがに掲載している上水道の状況です。 （データ項目）年次、給水人口、給水戸数、年間総配水量、年間総有収水量、有収率. Coverage: 日向市. The portal files it under the publisher 日向市. Its tags are 上水道. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
